dynamicMaskCandidates.disposition: Hand branch only summons a Hallo monster, per s.spfilter.
All origin branches require a Frute monster, per s.spfilter.
Ritual filter only admits Cyberse Ritual monsters.

stockCases.disposition: Confirmed and repaired in Musicale. It attributes the selected Hand summon to its resolving effect via a chain-scoped native summon record. Stock script is unchanged.

consumerReview.disposition: Reuse the prior audit of all 11 operation-info readers. Musicale is the only reader with the resolved, stock-compatible Nautica Hand condition. Oceanica requires a Nautica source. Casino and other readers check different categories or inspect the link at activation.
